scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-site-streak
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w functions
scripts.seed: npm run build -w packages/shared && node scripts/seed.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p scripts
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:emulators: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-site-streak --only auth,firestore,storage "npm test && npm run test:rules -w tests/rules"
